page.overview:
What is Warhammer Fantasy?

Warhammer Fantasy Battle, often abbreviated by fans as WFB, WHFB, or simply Warhammer, is the oldest and most popular tabletop miniature war game to use Game Workshop's original Warhammer setting of the Known World. The game's 8th Edition, released in 2010, was its last, as the setting was brought to an end in the apocalypse of the End Times and was replaced by a new high fantasy setting known as Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in 2015.

However, in 2024, Games Workshop released Warhammer: The Old World, a new iteration of the original tabletop game set in an earlier timeline in the 23rd century IC prior to the Great War Against Chaos.

The game is set in a dark fantasy world much like our own called the "Known World" or the "mortal world" by its inhabitants. It is home to a vast number of magical and fantastical beasts and intelligent races, each with their own civilisations, customs, and enmities.

Many are based on the traditional high fantasy races dating back to the works of J.R.R. Tolkien such as Men, Elves, Dwarfs, and Dragons, but many are also original, such as the Lizardmen, Skaven, and Ogres.

Also known as: Warhammer Fantasy Battle, WHFB, Old World Warhammer.
